posts.title_kr: 쿠키런 크럼블 169~248 스테이지 투력 35% 보스 공략 정리 영상
posts.title_en: Cookie Run Crumble stages 169–248 at 35% power: boss strategy roundup
posts.summary_en: 그니 shows the formation screen for each zone's general deck and for each boss in stages 169–248, recorded before the 2026-09-23 stage easing at the 35% power bracket. Every deck is built on the same core: 바삭튼튼 소아과 의사 우유 as captain and top-ATK cookie, with 피겨여왕, 브라이트시커, 마카롱, 석류, 정글전사, 케이크 들개 and 허브. Each boss swaps two or three cookies. The perks are 초고속 승진 + 열정페이, or 방어구 수리 특약 + 열정페이 when a deck fields three tanks. Team power runs 1.27G–1.5G. Gameplay frames show crispy clears of 243-20, 244-10, 246-10, 246-20, 247-10 and 247-30.

builds.sugar_runes: Give ATK sugar runes so it ranks 6th in ATK in the deck; otherwise the 6th ATK slot goes to 쿨링민트/체리콜라, 메론소다 or 허브, depending on the deck.
builds.why: Frames 0622, 0815, 1328 ('치즈 케이크 공격력 슈가룬 기준 6번째 / 아니라면 … 6번째 주시면됩니다'). Each deck also carries a '공격력 순위' (ATK ranking) with 우유 1st and 피겨 2nd. Reading (low confidence): ATK order matters because 초고속 승진 and 열정페이 buff the highest-ATK ally, and the healer's output scales with ATK.

mechanics: Captain perks: 초고속 승진 (highest-ATK ally ATK +7%), 열정페이 (highest-ATK ally ATK +20%, max HP −20%) and 방어구 수리 특약 (3+ tanks: ally DMG Reduction +10%), read from the perk cards on screen. The narrator says to use 초고속 승진 in place of 방어구 수리 특약 if your mercenary group is below Lv4 (0908).
The ATK ranking puts the healer-captain 우유 at #1, so the highest-ATK-ally perks land on 우유 (inferred).

The gameplay battle bar shows Lv.100 on most cards, with a few cards at 86–96 (e.g. 90, 91, 93, 94, 95, 96). Every card shows a row of stars. Individual cards are too small to map to cookies reliably.
stage_types: Group-mob (단체몹) stages get their own deck: the general deck with 전갈 swapped for 위치베리, or for 체리콜라 against the 레드베리 and 용암 와플 도마뱀 packs.
Boss 생크림콘 독수리 must be hit from range (0923): 딸기크레페 (melee tank) out, 치즈케이크 in.
Launch bosses (그루터기 정령, 망치공주, 슈가 와플 도마뱀) swap 호밀 for 메론소다. The 판다만두 pet (lift RES) is the intended pet; 얼음새 or 배터리 are the fallbacks.
비겁한 쿠키 has two decks: a sustain deck (3 healers, for when you can outlast it to the heal timing) and a three-tank 방어구 수리 deck.
Stage labels seen in gameplay: 243-10 바이커, 243-20 폭주단 트럭, 243-30 비겁한 쿠키, 244-10 생크림콘 독수리, 245-30 그루터기, 246-10 레드베리, 246-20 망치공주, 246-30 쿨링민트, 247-10 와플 도마뱀 무리, 247-30 슈가 와플 도마뱀.
